content:
Hello there! I see that you are performing the warrior one pose, but I noticed a few things that we can work on to improve your alignment.

Firstly, I see that your spine is not completely straight. To fix this, focus on lengthening through your spine by engaging your core muscles and pressing your tailbone down towards the mat.

Next, your arms are not straight up overhead as they should be in this pose. Take a moment to really reach through your fingertips and actively lift your arms towards the ceiling to achieve the full extension.

Lastly, I noticed that your knees are not directly over your ankles. Try to align your front knee directly above your front ankle to ensure proper alignment and stability in the pose.

Remember to breathe deeply and focus on creating a strong foundation through your feet and legs. Keep up the great work, and with consistent practice, you will improve your alignment and strength in the warrior one pose. Well done!
